DVC: git for data, and pipelines that know what is stale

The problem it solves

Git is built for code, not for gigabytes of data, and results depend on more than code: the data, the parameters and the order of the steps. A few weeks into a project nobody can say which data and which parameters produced which model, and comparing five runs means a folder of results with names like model_new_2.

The general idea

DVC adds data and pipelines on top of git. Data files stay out of git: git tracks small pointer files and DVC keeps the data in a cache and in a remote. A pipeline is a dvc.yaml file listing stages with their command, their dependencies, their parameters and their outputs. DVC records hashes of everything in dvc.lock, so it knows exactly which stages are stale and runs only those. Experiments are runs with different parameters that you can queue, compare and keep.

Examples

stages:
  panel:
    cmd: uv run python -m src.panel
    deps: [data/raw, src/panel.py]
    outs: [data/process/panel.jsonl]

  fit:
    foreach: ${split.folds}
    do:
      cmd: uv run python -m src.fit ${item}
      deps: [artifacts/split/${item}]
      params: [model, sampler]
      outs: [artifacts/fit/${item}]
uv run dvc repro                                  # run what is stale
uv run dvc exp run --queue -S model=nb -n nb      # queue an experiment
uv run dvc queue start
uv run dvc exp show                               # compare the runs

Tips from my setup

  • Always through uv. DVC is a dependency of the project and is run as uv run dvc, never installed globally. My DVC skill makes the coding agents follow the same rule.
  • Parameters in one file. Every stage reads its settings from params.yaml, so an experiment is a changed parameter and nothing else. foreach turns one stage definition into one stage per cross-validation fold.
  • Data out of git, results in. The global gitignore keeps data/ out of git, and DVC versions it. The lock file and the pointer files are what git commits.
  • A terminal UI on top. The command line output of dvc exp show is hard to read, so I built dvcat. See the next post.
  • It needs git. DVC builds on git state, which is why I could not switch to jj. See the post about jj.
